name: native-game-assets
goal: Scaffold native Three.js gameplay with AI rendering off and static asset authoring guidance.

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: Factory/CLI standardized tests fail on absent aiRendering:false (four red assertions); specification defines native cameras and saved art, no inference in gameplay. /tmp/native-scaffold-red.log

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
steps.evidence: Game scaffolds use Three.js for both camera dimensions, explicitly set aiRendering:false and document saved GPT Image/other-model assets. Existing adapters and app pages retained.

steps.title: Add or update focused automated coverage.
steps.evidence: Same factory/CLI red tests green; 11 focused tests including actual Three camera types and state preservation. Root owned-source suite 829 passed before new camera case, game package 17 passed. Fresh generated starter manually played in IAB 2D/3D, no browser errors; screenshots inspected. Desktop game service 5/5 passes at 15s timeout; default 5s times out. Broad check remains blocked by ignored dependency discovery and separate desktop suite failures.
